row: SportsCare Physical Therapy has been providing high-quality PT & sports medicine services since 1997. Our therapists are licensed/certified & professional athletic trainers, & each of our 70+ facilities offer state-of-the-art rehab technology & equipment. We are also the Official Physical Therapy Provider & Proud Partner of the NY Rangers and New York Red Bulls.
